title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kunon Gurion, born blind, is told his blindness marks him as a descendant of a legendary hero, but it feels more like a curse. At seven he learns magic can strengthen the weak, and he devotes himself to creating a spell that will let the blind see. His talent soon reaches the royal palace and the famed Royal Sorcerer Zeonly Finroll.
life_message: Curiosity, hard study and refusal to accept limits can turn a disability into a source of discovery.
